usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all configured authentication realms on the PDM instance — useful before attempting login, provisioning users, or validating that a specific realm (e.g. an LDAP or OpenID provider) is registered. Requires no authentication, so it can be called before any token is available. Returns only basic realm metadata; for detailed realm configuration use an authenticated admin endpoint.

examples.summary: List all authentication realms configured on the PDM instance

tips: The 'default' boolean field identifies the realm pre-selected on the login page; there will be at most one entry with default=true.
Realm type 'pam' refers to Linux PAM (local OS users), 'pdm' is the built-in PDM realm, 'openid'/'ad'/'ldap' are external providers.
This endpoint is unauthenticated (user: world) — safe to call before obtaining a session token or API token.
Use the returned 'realm' string as the realm component when constructing user IDs (e.g. 'root@pam', 'admin@ldap').
